intro_html: They want to be outside when you are, just not on the wet grass. Outdoor dog houses and day beds for supervised garden time, off the damp ground.
description_html:
If you're in the garden, so are they. Pottering while you weed, flat out by your chair on the first bright afternoon, keeping an eye on the gate. What they want is a spot of their own, off the wet grass and in the shade, close enough to keep watching you. These outdoor dog houses and day beds are for exactly that: supervised time outside together, not a place to leave them.

Two kinds of outdoor dog house

  • Kennels with a raised floor, for damp ground. Blencathra lifts the floor clear of wet grass, with a sloped shell and arched doorway that help rain run off and ventilation to let air through. Bedding is not included. Keswick also has a raised floor, plus an access ramp up to the entrance instead of a step.
  • Day beds with a canopy, for dry-weather lounging. Henley has a woven frame, a slanted canopy and an included cushion, and works in a bright conservatory in winter. Torver is a raised woven day bed with a canopy and a cushion. Both also sit among our luxury dog beds, for the look.

How to choose a dog kennel or day bed

  • If your lawn is wet most of the year: a raised-floor kennel, Blencathra or Keswick.
  • If they find a step awkward: Keswick's ramp, checked against your dog first.
  • If it is for a patio or decking on dry days: a canopy day bed, Henley or Torver.
  • If it is for indoors on warm days: a raised mesh bed from our elevated and cooling dog beds.

Then size. Exact dimensions aren't listed on these product pages, so please contact us before ordering. Check the internal resting area, the entrance height and the supported load: your dog should be able to walk in, stand, turn and lie down comfortably.

Using them safely

Supervise your dog, provide drinking water and safe shade, and move them indoors in extreme weather. A raised bed, canopy or kennel does not prevent overheating. The day beds are shade, not shelter, so bring the cushions under cover when you go in. None of these replaces a warm bed indoors.

Looking after them

The plastic shells on Blencathra and Keswick, and the woven frames on Henley and Torver, wipe down with a damp cloth and mild soap. Follow the separate care label for any cushion, store soft furnishings under cover, and let every part dry before use.

Returns on outdoor products

These are not part of the 100-night sleep trial, and we would rather you knew that up front. Outdoor dog houses and day beds have a 30-day change-of-mind window, with return at your cost. Your statutory rights are unaffected. Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Full details are on our delivery and returns page.

Outdoor dog house questions

Can my dog live in an outdoor kennel?

These aren't made for that. They're for supervised garden time in suitable conditions, and your dog should come indoors in extreme weather. Blencathra's own description puts it plainly: it is not a replacement for a warm bed indoors.

Is bedding included?

Henley and Torver come with a cushion. Blencathra does not include bedding. For Keswick, ask us before you order.

Are these dog houses weatherproof?

We don't describe them that way. Blencathra's sloped shell and arched doorway help rain run off, and both kennels have raised floors to keep them off wet ground. The day beds give shade, not shelter.

Looking for their indoor bed as well? The Bed Finder narrows the indoor range to one bed in a few questions.
